params.caption: 🕹️ One dev says Steam outsold Epic 148 to 1 A developer says their game sold 148 times more on Steam than on the Epic Games Store, and another said Epic brought in only 1.4% of their revenue compared with Steam. Not everyone agrees: a different studio says Epic saved it a fortune that would otherwise have gone to Valve. 🕒 Nov 19, 2026 · 18:22 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ 👥 @Steam · @EpicGames 🛒 Where do you buy PC games?
